name: Call Disposition
job: Single call-disposition graph, keyed on channel not clinic. Tags v2_source_phone. No remove-and-recreate pattern.

trigger.notes: One graph total; do not fork per clinic.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Call Status changed (channel=phone)
named_steps.comment: Sole call-dispo entry. Must not fork per clinic slug.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on call disposition (connected | voicemail | missed | wrong-number)
named_steps.comment: Single graph. Must not remove and recreate the contact or opp; native update in place.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.last_call_disposition
named_steps.comment: Native update in place. Must not delete-and-recreate.

named_steps.name: SMS: Voicemail follow-up (inline, voicemail branch)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Honors quiet hours 8am-9pm contact TZ.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_bad_number (wrong-number branch)
named_steps.comment: Delegates to compliance semantics; WF-11 still owns the field-level write.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route wrong-number to WF-11 Compliance
named_steps.comment: Compliance owns the DND and bad-number field writes.
